Method.name: SendMessage
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC=$method($this,"validateAndIndex",pMsgOut)
$$$LOGINFO("validateAndIndex " _ tSC _ ", name: " _ pMsgOut.Name ) Set tSC = ..Adapter.HL7Message(pMsgOut,.pResponse)
If ( $$$ISOK(tSC) && $IsObject(pResponse)) {
Set tReqId=pMsgOut.%Id(), pResponse.Source=tReqId Set tReplyTypeName=pResponse.Name $$$LOGINFO("ReplyType: " _ tReplyTypeName)
Set tReplyCategory=$S(""'=pMsgOut.MessageTypeCategory:pMsgOut.MessageTypeCategory,1:$P(pMsgOut.DocType,":"))
$$$LOGINFO("pMessageType " _ tReplyCategory_":"_pMsgOut.Name)
$$$LOGINFO("Call OnGetReplyAction Id: " _ tReqId) Set replyStr = ..OnGetReplyAction(pMsgOut, pResponse, .tSC) $$$LOGINFO("From OnGetReplyAction " _ replyStr _ " Stat: " _ tSC)
} Quit tSC
